offering_description.value: Provides outsourced insurance claims management and adjusting services for insurers, self-insured employers and legal settlement administrators. Handles claims investigation, case management and settlement on fee or contract terms, delivered by staff and independent adjusters worldwide.

primary_services.value: claims management; independent adjusting; workers' compensation case management; subrogation; legal settlement administration

items.detail: property and casualty insurers, self-insured employers, insurance carriers, law firms and corporate risk managers

end_markets.value: insurance; workers' compensation; property and casualty; legal settlements; employee benefits

items.detail: fees for handling and managing insurance claims for clients
contracted claims management and settlement administration programs
takes in claims files from insurers and employers and sells claims handling and adjusting services back to them

geography_served.detail: operates claims offices across many countries in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.detail: property and casualty claims, workers' compensation claims and legal settlement administration, sharing insurer and employer customers

items.detail: sales teams selling claims services directly to insurers, employers and law firms

regulatory_exposure.detail: medium: state and national insurance claims-handling rules, adjuster licensing and data privacy laws
